acceptance: Both make project-format-check and make project-lint run a selected-interpreter Ruff version validation before any Ruff formatting or rule evaluation, and mismatch fails closed.

Mismatch and unavailable-Ruff output identify expected/observed state where available and print repository-relative, hash-locked .venv recovery commands without secrets, credentials, paths, or gate bypass.

Parallel Work Item documentation requires exclusive worktrees, serializes shared generated evidence, and specifies a governed current-main successor instead of rebase, stash, archive rewrite, cross-worktree editing, or tool substitution.
guidelines: Use the same selected interpreter for validation and Ruff invocation; derive expected Ruff only from requirements-dev.in.
Fail closed before formatting or linting, and make recovery deterministic, secret-free, repository-relative, and non-destructive.
Document Agent orchestration boundaries without adding scheduler behavior or claiming a global Work Item state.
Preserve predecessor evidence; #710 does not retroactively resolve #622.

intent.problem: #622 created a valid red Outcome but could not finish because its active Summary was replaced after the before_edit checkpoint. Its source-level remedy remains necessary: current format execution lacks the locked Ruff precondition applied to lint, and recovery guidance is insufficient for a fresh worktree. Parallel guidance must make shared-evidence serialization and successor recovery explicit.
constraints: Preserve #622 red Outcome through the governed quarantine receipt already recorded for #710.
No lockfile, release, provider, predecessor, or sibling-worktree mutation.
Use strict lifecycle, a dedicated branch, focused tests before implementation, complete quality verification, one PR, and normal closure.
Never turn recovery guidance into a toolchain bypass or expose machine-specific data.
intent.rationale: A source-controlled check of the same interpreter before every Ruff action makes quality evidence reproducible. Clear locked-environment recovery and serialization rules prevent unsafe, ad hoc repair when a Work Item is blocked.

declaredIntent.summary: Require locked Ruff before format and lint, describe deterministic recovery, and make parallel recovery boundaries executable and legible.
